note: Capability adoption registry. Each entry binds one capability id to exactly one provider and assigns a posture. The audit joins this registry, the consumer's own manifests, and the consumer's capabilities[].consumes[] declaration; all three must agree before a capability counts as adopted. See docs/capabilities.md and openspec/changes/capability-adoption-gate/.
